comment: The one table of HAMH_COMPUTE_INSTANCES words. infra/test/instances.test.ts runs it through resolveComputeInstances (lib/config.ts) and scripts/tests/test_deploy_direct.py runs it through resolve_compute_instances (scripts/lib/deploy.py), so the two parsers cannot drift apart. It is the table of HAMH_TOOLS_MODE words (infra/test/fixtures/tools-mode.json) with the same rule: a setting of null is a variable that is not set, and only the six ASCII whitespace characters are trimmed.
